about_the_game:
Enter Somnum, a cooperative horror game where you and your friends are trapped in the same mysterious dream every night. To escape, you'll need to work together, solve puzzles, and gather energy while exploring eerie and surreal environments.

Each player has a unique ability and a personal drawback that affects progression. Teamwork, timing, and sharp thinking are essential if you hope to wake up… or risk being stuck in the dream forever.

  • 👻 1 to 4 player co-op

  • 🧠 Puzzles and team-based objectives

  • 🏙️ Unique levels like a floating city or a maze-like Japanese hotel

  • ⚠️ Time pressure and player-voted penalties between levels

Get ready to dream... or to face your nightmare.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes tense and frightening moments, with disturbing atmosphere and psychological stress. There is no explicit violence or gore, but the experience may be unsettling for sensitive players.
